note: Composites are promoted from base units on graph evidence only; nothing here is declared. binding counts implemented or observed edges between members; cohesion is internal / (internal + external) binding.  declared_composites holds each composite the ownership mapping declares (import-derived there) with the binding the graph sees on its links; import_only means no call, flow, spawn or shared state joins its files.  cross_domain lists file pairs in different domains joined by implemented or observed edges or by meeting at one endpoint.
